scientific_integrity: Two exact, finite-state symbolic models and ten separate rational full-state reconstructions corroborate analytic formulas; only the stated three-site and four-site geometries are proved.
scientific_limitations: The model uses two identical hardcore run-and-tumble particles, unit attempted hopping, symmetric independent reversal at a positive rate, and counts all successful hops. The proof does not cover larger rings or different event counts. Prior-spectrum studies may encode equivalent formulas implicitly; independent novelty assessment has not been performed.
title: A triangle-to-square reversal in successful-hop noise for two run-and-tumble particles
